For a safe Place in Medford, I can connect you now to the overnight warming shelter at 332 West sixth Street. Their numbers are five four one, seven seven nine, six six nine one — that’s five four one… seven seven nine… six six nine one — or four five eight, four eight eight, one two two zero. You can share as little as you want, and keep this voice-only.
originalTexts: First: if he shows up, get to staff or a public group right away, and call **9-1-1**: nine… one… one. For a safe place in Medford, I can connect you now to the overnight warming shelter at **332 West 6th Street**. Their numbers are **541-779-6691** — that’s five four one… seven seven nine… six six nine one — or **458-488-1220**. You can share as little as you want, and keep this voice-only.
